title: i18n(Ko): translate no matches message
body: ## What Translate the Korean message for the log search empty state. Updated: - `dag.json` - `logs.search.noMatches` ## Why This updates the assigned Korean translation entry. ## Testing - [x] Checked the updated translation entry - [x] pnpm lint ## Screenshots Please review this translation. /cc @kgw7401 @onestn
